fusions.name: Spore Flutter
fusions.desc: Shakes out a cloud of spores in a 4-tile cone that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds, its attacks slowed.

fusions.name: Spreading Rot
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 11 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Mother's Cloche
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. It heals 6% more for each ally beside you, up to 24%.

fusions.name: Swelling Cap
fusions.desc: When your health is full, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 9 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
